title: Hamstring Tendinopathy
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. positions.as_written: Ask the patient to flex the knee against resistance and note whether that reproduces the pain, which localises it to the hamstrings.
Repeat with the knee in different flexion angles, since a tendon's tenderness changes with tension.
Assess the joint line and the posterior joint line separately, because a posterior horn tear produces pain in the same region.
